[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..fAaTVLqcbnx07qEsWV0UvVhMq8sHTOs-DfaVByjjpS8?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=219819653)
The "first vessel" Weichai is building in Qingdao is a bare aluminum catamaran hull - a far cry from a luxury yacht - with the form and wheelhouse of a crew-transfer or wind-farm service vessel. Weichai's narrator describes a wheelhouse module in the same hall as "mainly used for the daily operation and maintenance of offshore wind turbines."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e34d2877-8d74-4a5e-8eb8-74bc3cf094aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/aa68edcf-2a6e-48a5-b473-c9acbaba863d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Then the camera pans to an empty production line. The caption reads: "This line can build vessels of up to 80 meters."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/35af4561-f55e-4bac-9c91-3cc57bce5076?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Eighty meters is 262 feet. That is not a yacht line for the Chinese middle class. That is superyacht and patrol-vessel territory, and it is the exact size range where Ferretti's expertise lives. Ferretti's CRN brand builds custom steel superyachts of 50 meters and more, and its FSD division [builds fast patrol boats and interceptors](https://substack.com/redirect/e6d77540-0726-4941-b8b6-2dc792e3e43d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for the Italian Navy, Coast Guard, and police.
The film closes with a rendering of a planned research and commercial center, and the narrator says Phase 2 is "also in planning."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5956050c-4cad-44e5-9397-2fed07557d60?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
To confirm what Weichai's own footage shows, Loomered.com obtained Copernicus Sentinel-2 satellite imagery of the site on four dates: April 21, 2022, May 17, 2024, July 29, 2025, and August 2, 2026. The imagery confirms the construction timeline in the Chinese press record. It also adds what the state-controlled Chinese press didn't provide: a look at the entire facility after the shipyard was commissioned.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ecc53713-9a32-4738-892e-37a69c374f8e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/60d32e3f-7c04-4bd7-98e6-d88d5ccf74e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
By May 2024, the halls and pier were complete. By August 2026, the pontoon berths had been added and a few small craft were tied up alongside. But in every single pass, there is no hull and no large component anywhere outside the halls. The vessels at the pier are small craft of the kind that would serve a marina, not a shipyard.
Communist China built a shipyard with an 80-meter production line and a half-kilometer quay, and more than two years after the halls were finished, nothing of any size has come out of it. Why would a state-owned company build that much capacity and leave it idle?
Because the yard was never built for what Weichai knows how to make. It was built for what Ferretti knows how to make.
Weichai has said so itself, repeatedly, on its own corporate website. On December 16 and 17, 2023, Tan Xuguang, the chairman of Weichai who at the time was also chairman of Ferretti, chaired a meeting in Hong Kong on Ferretti's 2024 budget and five-year business plan. According to [Weichai's own account](https://substack.com/redirect/eb8bd63d-539f-4342-8aa2-bd3f4cf1cf1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), he told Ferretti's management that the group should move rapidly to land the Ferretti brand in China by "seizing the opportunity of the Weichai Qingdao marine equipment manufacturing project entering production," so that Ferretti would become "the undisputed pearl" of the yacht industry.
That is the most direct link on the public record between the Qingdao plant and the Ferretti brand, and it was made by the man who was chairing both companies at once.
On May 18, 2024, Tan went to Ferretti's headquarters in Milan and chaired a working meeting on yacht and propulsion-system integration. [Weichai's account of that meeting](https://substack.com/redirect/9aab2f37-7434-4e55-815f-4ed9c92c4519?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has him calling for the "deep industrial and technological value" of the Weichai-Ferretti reorganization to be fully exploited, and inviting Ferretti's Italian specialists to Weifang for face-to-face technical exchange with Weichai's engineers, in order to build core technical advantages "that others do not have." The same release reports that Ferretti's then chief executive committed to adopting Weichai high-power-density engines and silent generating sets across Ferretti's range.
None of this is new. When Weichai first bought into Ferretti in 2012, its acquisition announcements stated that Ferretti would set up a research and development center and a component-supplier system in China, bringing "the world's leading boat-development technology and Italian industrial design technology" into China to develop luxury yachts, government service craft, and commercial vessels for the Chinese market. A "government service craft" is code for a military vessel.
Weichai was the exclusive title sponsor of the 2025 Qingdao International Yacht Conference, held July 11 through 13, 2025. [Its release for the event](https://substack.com/redirect/75dd4b3a-8141-4a63-9a47-f18292b4ff13?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) states that Weichai marine diesels and silent generating sets are already fitted to Ferretti's F580 and INFYNITO 90, and that vessel models from Changzhou Fiberglass Boatyard, Bostar's parent company, were exhibited alongside them, with Weichai-powered craft in service as yachts, leisure boats, passenger vessels, and "government service boats."
Qingdao supplies the venue. Ferretti supplies the product. Changzhou Fiberglass supplies the building capacity. And the Chinese state supplies the money and the dock.
Remember who Weichai is. It was founded in 1946 to make rifles for the PLA. It has built tank engines for the PLA since the 1970s. Its engines power the [PHL-11 rocket launcher](https://substack.com/redirect/839c800e-37ae-45d9-99ca-a6654c0ef9bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the blacklisted arms giant NORINCO supplies to the Chinese military. Its parent, Shandong Heavy Industry Group, answers to SASAC, the Chinese state asset commission that appears 74 times in the Pentagon's [Section 1260H list](https://substack.com/redirect/49612f08-17cb-47ef-a787-08a8e025ae44?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of Chinese military companies.
A company with that pedigree now controls a European builder of naval patrol boats and interceptors, holds eight of nine seats on its board, and has a finished shipyard with an 80-meter line sitting empty in the home port of the PLA's Northern Theater Command. This is what China's "military-civil fusion" strategy looks like in a satellite photo: buy the company, build the yard, move the technology, and feed it to the PLA.
If Washington does nothing, the next thing these satellites photograph will not be Italian yachts; it will be Chinese military vessels built with advanced European technology.
Indiana GOP Senator Jim Banks has already [asked](https://substack.com/redirect/52063efa-5378-478c-8410-cc227fde91c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Secretary of War Pete Hegseth to add Weichai to the 1260H list. Secretary Hegseth should grant that request, and American companies, brokers, and buyers should stop doing business with Ferretti Group until the Italian government removes Weichai from control of the company.
Communist China does not need to fire a single shot to take what it wants from the West. It just needs us to keep looking the other way while it builds its super Navy.

body:
We have to take back the levers of power before it’s too late
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2517%2E791427%2E2ytWyU)
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-dhs-oct26.4A7Axt&refcode=em261013-1-210&t=2&akid=2517%2E791427%2E2ytWyU)
Friend, yesterday was tough. Trump’s DHS agents raided my home in a brazenly political escalation of their completely ludicrous investigation.
I will admit, it was scary to see this fascist intimidation tactic play out in my own home. **But what really scares me is not what happened to me, but what’s happening to regular people across the country.**
Think about it: If Trump and DHS are bold enough to send their goons to the home of a Congresswoman, what are they willing to do to regular people who don’t have the same platform to speak out?
I saw this firsthand earlier this year in Minneapolis, when ICE stormed into my community and threw the Constitution in the trash on the way in.
People’s homes were broken into without proper warrants. Cars were rammed or smashed into in traffic. US citizens were arrested without the chance to prove their citizenship. Thousands were held in indefinite detention, many unjustly. People were stopped in the street and harassed simply for looking Latino, Somali, or any other background with large immigrant communities. **Two of my constituents were shot dead — murdered — by ICE agents who walked free without any accountability.**
What I went through yesterday pales in comparison to this lawlessness, and all of it is part of the Trump administration's steady descent into authoritarianism and autocracy. **We have to take back the levers of power before it’s too late to stop this madness.**
[**I am in awe of how this progressive movement has stood with me in the last 24 hours, and I’m respectfully asking for your help to keep up the momentum. Please, chip in $5, $20, any amount you can afford today, and help me fight back against Trump’s abuse of power.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-dhs-oct26.4A7Axt&refcode=em261013-1-210&t=3&akid=2517%2E791427%2E2ytWyU)

## Why I am voting YES on the IPS Operating Referendum
---
**District 46 Neighbor, **

**I am sending you my statement on the critical moment we find ourselves in, and why I am supporting the IPS Operating Referendum: **

"The future of IPS will be decided over the next 21 days. I am supporting the 2026 operating referendum to ensure families in our community have access to a high-quality, well-funded public education.

"The promise of a quality education is what ensures growing families stay in Indianapolis; that they invest their time and talent into our collective future. Thriving cities with strong communities require strong school systems.

"The challenges IPS faces are not unique; nearly 40 Indiana school districts from rural, suburban and urban backgrounds are seeking referenda to ensure students have access to essential services.

"The question we should be asking is not if we should support a school referendum. The question is why are we put in this position to begin with? This statewide trend is a direct result of decisions made by the statehouse Republicans: decisions that continue to hurt public school districts, Hoosier families and future generations. Most notably, the supermajority-controlled General Assembly passed legislation that diverts funds from public schools to pay for the private school education of the wealthiest families in the state.

"The cost for the voucher policy alone? Over $500 million a year. The cost of funding all 38 referenda across our state? Around $500 million annually.

"Instead of fully funding special education programs or other essential services, the General Assembly chose taxpayer-funded subsidies for private school education and then hastily passed property tax cuts for those with the highest valued homes, leaving schools around the state bracing for building closures, larger classroom sizes and cuts to transportation services.

"I spent over a decade of my public education career working for IPS students and families. My daughters are IPS high school students, blessed to have excellent teachers and coaches setting them up for their future. And, in my Near Eastside neighborhood where a majority of families send their kids to IPS schools, I know who will suffer if this referendum doesn't pass. This is personal.

"It is personal to all those who have proudly attended IPS, raised their families here and have aspirational goals for the education of their children and grandchildren following in their footsteps.

"A referendum isn't a goal. It's a tool school districts are being forced into. After November 3, we can continue conversations about how we fix public schools funding in our state. Until then, we have to use the resources we have today to ensure we have strong public schools now.

"By guaranteeing IPS has the resources to continue serving students today, we guarantee the opportunity to continue working towards having the strongest public schools in the country right here in our community."
**It is an honor to work alongside you to deliver a future our children can be proud of. **

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1792, the [cornerstone of the White House](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGPozAQBeBfA52RxyYQChfX0OXaK9FghnhujR3Zs0H596us9h9s_em9J71_t-WGHDnd_-JBTva8JDprJBEqC8eAKR9YCvL2wML1wPJBsi9Gm0GBVmAX9MJPWnpsN7cTGbItORgnuF4vEwxtcGuvJ2OhH8fRwwaTRsCLHQ14v1_R7C27dx9osKD1BWy3DivoXoNeYTD96pte08aSS_c_c5JAe3zlJ5XO56ONLog8amP_NGZuzHyeZxe4Si6vtzdmlsBVbfhSnNSPNGbOXvJKRYF9hwILqZA_KymfS6JSJSdSEXlri9seJ8fIdRibXt8P5Pg9Lb987OnMVwAAAP__AzKBjw) was laid at the site chosen by President George Washington and Pierre Charles L'Enfant, city planner for the nation's new capital. name: The PreBorn! Team
subject: What Does God Call Success?
body:
It's easy to assume that God measures our lives the way the world does.

| | | | [](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckL2O3CAUhZ8Gd7bM38VTUESynGqTTZOUiIG7HiQMCPDO60dOMi-Q9p6jT989v97Mmw0xpP2bPVDvuRRTm3k-bPcZ2569szG20zlszbCZwUjnkXJjXQ-faIQdvBYWBAAMqKm60WUBSeXw0O6DKQtUeTkzQKkckwhKLDeE5XYHOgR9AelMOZ2ppGICsUglPZMe8P4BnIgZfei5TpdYxRY8ph5snFw-hqgfvZdG-BfCNsK2ii2f1WGbSsV7rulqEbY9McbR54RjIXw7-2H-9ghfS82toOsh7YTBFR3ow3kQvuJhQ_x3dPYoNuyJ8PWCXaxXklPH1Alff1LzQ41fv7-_j6-vhqp9eYYYQwNFxLxfyD_q_b-W_tTsdwAAAP__z9aOAQ)
---
Friend of Life, It's easy to assume that God measures our lives the way the world does. After all, we're constantly surrounded by messages telling us to accomplish more, earn more, influence more, and become more. Success is usually measured by what people can see...In Scripture, we see something entirely different. Again and again, God reminds us that He is looking for faithfulness. When Jesus told the parable of the talents, He didn't praise the servant who had the most abilities or the greatest opportunities. He commended the servants who were faithful with what had been entrusted to them. That truth has encouraged us many times at PreBorn!. Most of us will never be famous. We may never write a book that reaches millions, preach to a packed stadium, or lead a large ministry. But every one of us has opportunities each day to be faithful. Opportunities to love our families well, to serve our churches, to encourage someone who's hurting, to share the hope of Christ, and to use the gifts God has given us for His glory. Those moments may seem ordinary, but Scripture reminds us that they are anything but ordinary. They are part of a life that echoes into eternity. # One Last Thought Until Next Week
---
| | |
---
Hey everybody,
This week, I had hoped to send out some motivating words for the final three weeks of the campaign. Hopefully this motivates you, but it's not how I wanted to do it. Last week, three stories hit the news, and my opponent, Mike Rogers, Chair of the House Armed Services Committee, should have been mentioned repeatedly.
The first was a story about an Iranian attack on a US logistics base in Kuwait. Six US soldiers were killed, and dozens were wounded. The immediate aftermath revealed that the Department of Defense had failed to plan for casualties from Iranian attacks.
Second, Defense Secretary Hegseth announced that Nidal Hasan, who killed thirteen soldiers at Fort Hood, TX, would be publicly executed. In addition to handing our adversaries their greatest propaganda victory in a decade, the execution would be the first public execution in the US in nearly 100 years.
Third, President Trump announced that the US will buy 800,000 metric tons of diesel fuel from Russia in a last-ditch effort to bring down prices before the midterms. Follow this logic: Trump is buying diesel from Russia, which financially supports Iran, to lower high diesel prices that were driven by Trump's war with Iran. Seriously, you really can't make this up.
Each of these stories should have drawn immediate attention from the House Armed Services Committee, and the first two should have led to investigations and inquiries, but you guessed it: Mike Rogers, the committee chair, has said nothing.
Mike has been home since September 18th, when Speaker Johnson closed the House two weeks early to avoid debating a measure to impeach Hegseth. Since then, Rogers has had no public meetings. He has made no public statement. He has simply been incommunicado. If Rogers were in the Armed Forces, he would be charged under Article 92 of the Uniform Code of Military Justice, Dereliction of Duty.
We deserve better leadership in Washington. We deserve accountability. We deserve legislators who want to do their job.
We deserve better.
There are 21 days until the general election. The last day to register to vote is October 19th.
Be well.

We'll talk soon,

Lee

body:
There's a bigger picture here
Three states are about to decide a lot more than 2026.

| | | |
---
Fellow Patriot,
---
We've looked at the polling in every swing state and swing race in the country. It's margin of error, either way, almost everywhere.

At this point, it's not about winning anybody over. _It's about who actually shows up._

If conservatives turn out in November, we'll win every critical battleground and lay the groundwork for victory in 2028 and beyond.

That's why Turning Point Action is focusing all our efforts on three key states: Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.

**We call these states the new RED WALL.**

_Let me explain why they matter so much... _

After 2024, Charlie looked at the numbers, looked at the maps, and told our team something simple. If we lock down Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire, the Left's entire strategy falls apart. Their map collapses. Their path back to power disappears.

Here's why... Winning the presidency comes down to 270 electoral votes. Lose Arizona and most of the realistic paths to the White House in 2028 are gone. Lose Nevada and New Hampshire and the Left rebuilds the Blue Wall they lost in 2024.

Whoever wins in 2028 controls the 2030 Census. The Census drives redistricting. Redistricting sets the congressional map for the next ten years.

This midterm decides which way that goes.
---

## **Your Generosity Just Put Us on Two More Radio Stations!**
---
First, I want to sincerely thank everyone who has made such kind and generous contributions to Beck for Congress. Your support means more to me than you know.
With many political campaigns, contributions go into a huge fundraising pool, and donors may never know exactly where their money goes.
**With Beck for Congress, I want you to know exactly what your contributions are accomplishing!**
Thanks to your recent generosity, we've purchased even more radio advertising!
**Starting Wednesday, October 14, our commercials will begin airing on two additional Milwaukee stations:**
* **WMIL – FM 106.1**
* **WRIT – FM 95.7**

These join our existing advertising on WKLH 96.5, WHQG 102.9 (The Hog), and WTKM.
**That means our commercials will generate over 220,000 estimated listener impressions EVERY WEEK across four Milwaukee radio stations, PLUS additional exposure on WTKM!** That's nearly **660,000 estimated radio impressions over the next three weeks** , not including WTKM!

**Just three weeks remain until Election Day, November 3.**
If you've already contributed, thank you! And if you're able to help us one more time, your contribution will go directly toward getting our message in front of more voters.

This campaign has never been about big money or political insiders. It's about ordinary people coming together to make a difference.

Andy

# Tuesday, October 13, 2026
---|---
**Good Morning!** On this day in 1680, Franciscan friars [founded a mission](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD1vgzAQhn8NbCB_YAyDhy5s6doROfYBJxkc-U4k6a-vEnXs1vXV-6Xn6zJfPCY81k-_g-PHkucD7pSAGcrsd0wJ8_Gd84mEnAutnm4FZyVU30jRSD37wHjC3Pk6uquIo6zBSTvKYRi1EvXmjLamiyGM1kphVIBFD9aoa_Ta9CbqGt2rTgqppRTS2Ba6QdoOukXZ4Wp7X3UC4mu-5Q0YHp6W9MwnlDbkvU5uY75RpT8qNVVq4i20b1O75rNSE7FnaDYkzgVDQ8hAlZpyig3lkEvJzY5EmI-_1d_osy4u3u4vItTbqhPr7jG9H_B_yZ1O_QQAAP__zBmGxA) near present-day El Paso for Spanish and Pueblo refugees fleeing the Pueblo Revolt in New Mexico. Its early church grounds are the oldest known mission site in Texas. _Et Cetera_ has an item about the volunteers who tackled 23 projects together on a community day of service in Abilene. We're curious: Have you served during an event like that? If so, what kinds of projects have you worked on? How many benefits come with the credit card in your wallet? Buried in the benefits guide that most cardholders never open are protections that can be worth real money. One can cover your hotel and meals when a flight strands you overnight, another the phone in your pocket. But the coverage only counts if you know it's there, and plenty of people don't. In one survey, almost 40% of cardholders had no idea they carried the benefit at No. 1 on our list. So what's already on your card, and how do you use your perks? Ayla has the full story on today's episode of _The Flyover Podcast_. [Tune in here](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykz7FuwyAUheGngS0WF7CBgaFLtnTtiLC5JEjYWICcpE9fueobdD_6j76vm7v5lNN2__Qr2v6KxW34bBl7x-r8mnJOZfsu5Ugt9VLb3be9JscZny7ALiCcX3o60ElPg51ZMEDRgjKgtRGc0YdFzRflxbgoDVMUbGQKMSLiHI2ZRkOTPXPAQAAwGNWAUoOSKCNXelaTJ5JhOO-H_sCOL99ifpcD67CUlWb76H1vRHwQfiX8WnGufgtDfhN-_RvuJVRccOu02rA_T1abFJHsvvqUfzP9v_zD8p8AAAD__63BcVM)! Today's sponsor, [Infinity Fuel](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLtu3DAQRb-G6nbBl0WqYBHA2M5pUxKz4kgagA-BpGQ7Xx_ICfIDbudczL04v978G1CkvP6EhK5_LMVnfG8Re8fqIVGMVPLvUk5q1EttK7S9kpdcjjfBb0J5mDud6DUMwT15mMSATphJWDspyYfNKa0tTjqE8QlhnPjMAy7IpzCDlfCEgdz1TnChhODixdxRW2E06kUa-zQjMM0xXPX3vmHHD2hL_Cwn1vtc0hDd1vvemPrB5IPJB-UTW79TXihT_1wOjFfugupx9ORbOeqMTL1iAopMjtcxYaAjMfW6A4XbDrVnrG2j_R-fIe1Aa_5K_IfC8pvmxv9VcWTq4F-0EpM1yloxVBf290tiGw3TfL0Kv0b378o-nfwTAAD__0Fglo0), is developing hydrogen fuel cell technology capable of powering long-duration missions for customers like the U.S. Navy and NASA, with more than $60 million in past and current contracts.

## Man Struck by ICE SUV in Custody
An ICE agent's SUV [struck a man](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGSpDAMRU9jMnfZggE6INiEbDbdkBK2aFRjMGWrYdjTb3mvMIkSqfT_e38-p0_kwPvrN240yPcSp52uHEiE0oQbh8Bx_xvjyZklpvzCfCSewECrrdG2ntAJnzQ1WPlhNv5pKxps97R9_6zBVOtQG29hnmFxvqfFm6dr0BPatoYP28624qG8s8bW1hr70T2o6W3XULNA189di6ox5Ev8Q1YS-sa8hDuelB4ublUYVpEjq_qXglHBeF3XwwV2X7DGd5a4lysFYwFTMIboMCgYS6aC0ZoyoCz4JL0U5ltL1EeKJ3vS78OjkMZFKOkNd50lvd2Xnm_NjvRJK7tAmnd9URa9YkqctYvvXW4FY5UGf1zFY2471ZjXhhz-95af-j4H-BcAAP__z1aXsg) running from immigration agents Saturday morning near Clay Road and Highway 6 in west Harris County, leaving him with two injured legs, including one broken in three places. ICE said agents were after Jose Mendoza-Cervantes, who has four DUI arrests and two prior deportations, when Miguel Parra-Hernandez ran in front of [an agent's SUV](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2ypCAUhVeDGRYgIgQEk5j1pBNaV-61pQalCxntntW_8m3hxafO3_fnMT0gprg_f8NGvr6XPO10HYlqpTLBFlOKef-f8xmPWHM5nnC8SpyUUIZLwWU3QajxpElDg34W6GRDXg5OWus6JZrVI809IXSzQNlpM9gFwIHVyjjTKRJN9HecFLKTUsh-aElbOWjSixrsPBhgWhDe9W1dqdIbjiV98kmlDXlrkl9rfR2s-8XUyNR4XVf7N9Bez1tmaoRSY0jE1Hh_Y2pMOUBiagwJPrxkQL7BztdYeYDCF0IqkDj8q2susUa6Pcr2PKBxuMzILZqea-EctygFx9maWfc2CLRN8fi6bm6HGZgWzw1i-t5Zf8r39OorAAD__5nTj0I), according to ICE. Deputies said the agent was trying to box him in. Parra-Hernandez's attorney, Kim Bruno, said her client has [never met Mendoza-Cervantes](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2S3CAQhJ8GZWzBwOknUOBE2Tl1qBrBsBoXAhWwuls_vUt-Bcdd1d3f9-tz_USOnJ4_8aC5fYe8JvqqkVqjsuLBMXJOf3K-uHLLpT6xnoVXUNBLraQ2K7rGF60WOz9vyk-6o1kPkx7HyYDq9hlwMwi9dtaFCcbe2Y-BFJqwBQIM2PF812mljdZKfwwPsqMeLNkAw7gNPQqryN_zj7ZTo2-sIb7zReXh8tHFeW_trML8ELAIWHBz2tyJgOXMtQlYwk3ylgcmWV5Jcvr9KuQlO5K-8EVJXrSziySffJF8nR4bSZeT58Y5CVj0NBkYjBWwdGX259dtpvaDsOp5IMd_T9r_Grxm-BsAAP__mPuHXw). Parra-Hernandez remains in ICE custody, and Bruno said agents have kept her from seeing him. ICE said Parra-Hernandez is in the country illegally. His niece said [he's lived here 34 years](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0EGSpCAQBdDT4A6DRBRYsJiNu57tLI0U0iqiUSqA1q45_YRzhT5A5v___flYPjCmeDx-406ufW95OeiqiVqjsuAeU4r5-JvzGWtsudQH1leJixRy4iA4DAv6Fk9aFHbBrSJY6MiBtmCMHaTons4GJZTZtF21tevovUCp7QgWjbAofBfd_Q4EDAACRt2TMqAVqU1qs-oJmRIU7vi-PanRN9YtvfNJpfd575J7tvaqbPjF5MzkfF1X79cKtm8nkzOWFn0iJud7GZNzyh4Tk3P0xC-qjT-xlFi5z19He_MdD15b-fKffLsB3ry-CD_vS2lG7jdvVAgTl2BGriYzcAxAHEFrr60KVmJXXHhdt12dNFPisWNM_7u2nxqfTv4LAAD__wVDj_I) with no criminal record. name: Bernie Sanders
subject: I am, once again, asking for your financial support:
body:
[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1001&akid=139%2E42639%2EBtxpTD ]Chris Deluzio for PA

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.AE9VfX&refcode=em261012-bernie&refcode2=139.42639.BtxpTD&t=1002&akid=139%2E42639%2EBtxpTD ]Bernie Sanders and Chris Deluzio

Sisters and Brothers –

The political future of our country rests upon one very simple principle:
the need for working people to stand together and fight back against
corporate greed, and create an economy that works for all of us, and not
just billionaires and large corporations.

So when we have progressive candidates with the guts to take on corporate
power in this country, we have to do what we can to support them if we are
going to have any chance at transforming this country and creating a
government that works for all of us.

One of those people is Congressman Chris Deluzio in Pennsylvania.

Chris understands that our current healthcare system is broken and wildly
expensive. He believes, as I do, that healthcare is a human right, not a
privilege, and that we must end the embarrassment of being the only major
country on earth that does not guarantee healthcare to every man, woman
and child. That is why he supports Medicare for All.

Chris understands that we have a corrupt campaign finance system which
allows the very rich and their super PACs to buy and sell politicians.
That is why he fights vigorously to end the disastrous Citizens United
Supreme Court decision — which allows Big Money to control our political
process.

Chris understands that too many workers in America are earning starvation
wages. That is why he fights to raise the minimum wage to a living wage,
to make it easier for workers to join unions, to build the millions of
units of low income and affordable housing this country desperately needs
and make sure that seniors can retire with dignity and security.

Sisters and brothers, Chris' campaign is about more than just one single
House seat. His work is about taking on the powerful special interests
that dominate our economic and political life.

And keeping him in Congress requires all of us to do our part to make it
happen. And that is why I am once again asking for your financial support.

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.AE9VfX&refcode=em261012-bernie&t=1003&akid=139%2E42639%2EBtxpTD ]Please contribute $27 or whatever you can afford to Chris Deluzio's
campaign for Congress in Pennsylvania. I intend to do my part, but it will
take all of us. Not just me. Us.

If you've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution
instantly:

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/362?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.b9L7t3&refcode=em261012-bernie&t=1022&akid=139%2E42639%2EBtxpTD ]Donate $5

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/35?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.nJj1HV&refcode=em261012-bernie&t=1023&akid=139%2E42639%2EBtxpTD ]Donate $25

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/29?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.E2bBFL&refcode=em261012-bernie&t=1024&akid=139%2E42639%2EBtxpTD ]Donate $50

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/30?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.zNz5CJ&refcode=em261012-bernie&t=1025&akid=139%2E42639%2EBtxpTD ]Donate $100

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/31?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.u3Q1jZ&refcode=em261012-bernie&t=1026&akid=139%2E42639%2EBtxpTD ]Donate $250

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/34?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.kjyCBj&refcode=em261012-bernie&t=1027&akid=139%2E42639%2EBtxpTD ]Other Amount

When we act collectively, we have the ability not only to create a dynamic
progressive movement, but we will be able to transform our nation and
create a government that represents all of us, not just the people on top.

That’s the goal. Let’s do it.

In solidarity,

Bernie Sanders

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.AE9VfX&refcode=em261012-bernie&t=1028&akid=139%2E42639%2EBtxpTD ]CONTRIBUTE NOW

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.AE9VfX&refcode=em261012-bernie&refcode2=139.42639.BtxpTD&t=1029&akid=139%2E42639%2EBtxpTD ]'Pittsburgh Post Gazette: State, federal lawmakers rally in support of
Allegheny County paid parental leave policy -- Allegheny County Executive
Sara Innamorato was joined by Democratic state and federal officials
Thursday in issuing a call for the county health board to pass
Innamorato’s proposed paid parental leave policy next week. The county
health board is scheduled to vote on the proposal — which would provide 12
weeks of paid parental leave for eligible county residents — on Monday. If
passed, the measure will go before County Council next month. Innamorato,
who is due to give birth to her first child this fall, was joined by
lawmakers including U.S. Reps. Chris Deluzio and Summer Lee, state Reps.
La’Tasha Mayes and Aerion Abney, and state Sen. Nick Pisciottano, at a
press conference at the Western Pennsylvania Diaper Bank in Point Breeze.
“These are elected representatives who don’t just talk about being
pro-family, but are actually willing to step up, to spend political
capital, and to take the action necessary to get pro-family policies
across the finish line,” Innamorato said. Monday’s vote will follow months
of debate on the issue. The policy that goes before the health board has
been revised since the original proposal that would have provided 18 weeks
of paid parental leave. Brought for public comment in May, the initial
plan received mixed reactions from hundreds of county residents who
submitted comments to local officials. In response, the Board of Health
announced sweeping changes to the policy earlier this month, reducing the
length of paid leave to 12 weeks and implementing a small-business cap
that would exempt businesses with fewer than 15 employees. “The county
listened to feedback on the paid parental leave policy and we made several
adjustments,” Innamorato said. More than a dozen states have enacted
mandatory paid parental leave policies, while another nine have adopted
voluntary paid parental leave systems that allow the benefit in the
private insurance market. Pennsylvania has no statewide parental leave
policy, although Sen. Pisciottano, D-Allegheny, introduced legislation in
March that would provide 12 weeks of paid leave to employees who have
worked their jobs for at least a year. That bill was referred to committee
upon introduction but has yet to receive a committee vote or hearing.
Meanwhile, the state House passed a paid family and medical leave bill in
March. That legislation has since stalled in the Republican-controlled
Senate. In June, the Pennsylvania Senate Labor and Industry Committee
voted 9-2 in a bipartisan move to pass the Family Care Act, which would
establish a paid family and medical leave program for up to 20 weeks for
eligible workers for the birth of a child or a serious personal medical
issue. Sponsor Devlin Robinson, R-Allegheny, said the act would fund the
program through employee payroll contributions and be administered by the
state Department of Labor and Industry. The legislation has yet to go to
the Senate floor for a vote. A federal paid parental leave policy — the
FAMILY Act — was introduced in September 2025 and would create a national
paid family and medical leave insurance program. The bill — co-sponsored
by U.S. Reps. Deluzio and Lee, among others — was referred to committee
upon its introduction, but has not advanced to a House floor vote. “Let’s
be honest, this is an issue that should be handled at a federal level,”
Lee said. “We shouldn’t have to be here, county by county, municipality by
municipality, or state by state, ensuring our families are taken care of.”
In lieu of that legislation, Deluzio applauded Innamorato and her
administration for pursuing a paid parental leave policy locally. “When
you go through something as important as starting a family, having a baby,
you shouldn’t be risking your job or your safety to care for yourself and
your baby,” he said. Deluzio said that he supported the recent changes to
the Allegheny County proposed policy made, in part, in response to input
from small business owners. “They were smart,” he said. “They reflected
feedback from the community and small business owners, especially.” State
Rep. La’Tasha Mayes, co-chair of the Black Maternal Health Caucus, said
most mothers, about 60%, return to work within three months of giving
birth — many within six to eight weeks. “You bring a baby into the world
and then you must return to work,” she said. “Your life has changed. Your
mind has changed. Your body has changed. Your thoughts should be about how
you heal and how you take care of your new baby, but the competing
thoughts are, ‘I’ve got to get back to work.’” Mayes said the policy would
ultimately help prevent maternal deaths, particularly for Black women who
have a significantly higher rate of maternal mortality than the national
average, and two and a half times higher than their white counterparts,
according to the county health department. Nationally, the CDC found that
the U.S. maternal mortality rate was 17.9 deaths per 100,000 live births
in 2024. '

| | | |

# Peter,
---
There's now a law in California with my name associated with it. Everyone in Sacramento knows exactly what the **"Stop Nick Shirley Act"** means. On August 22nd, Governor Newsom signed AB 2624. Three days later, I was standing at the State Capitol with a crowd of people who showed up because they understood what this law _actually_ does.

Here's what it really does, Peter: **it makes it harder for anyone -- me included -- to investigate where your tax dollars are being sent.** I said it plainly at the rally: this is not the end; _this is just the beginning._ Because here's the part that should bother you more than anything else. **The assemblymember who wrote this bill is married to California's Attorney General** -- the _one person_ in this state whose entire job is supposed to be going after fraud. Instead, his wife wrote the bill that makes it harder to expose it. That's not a coincidence, Peter. That work is exactly why a state legislature decided to write a law with my name on it instead of going after the fraud I keep finding. A state senator at the rally called it unconstitutional. A city attorney called it a direct threat to the First Amendment. _They're right_ -- and they're not going to be the ones who stop it. That's going to take people willing to fund the reporters still asking the questions. clean_body: | | | | Good morning, Peter! It’s Cait. I only have a few spare moments this morning before the day gets going, so please forgive the lack of polish here. Here’s what I want you to keep in mind before you start your day: 1. Our last FEC deadline is coming up, and the fundraising numbers we report are public. It’s important that we show we have the resources to compete, especially since Mike Lawler has more money than we do. 2. Donald Trump was in New York recently because Republicans think that this state is their key to surviving the midterms. He has invested millions of dollars here—and is spending more on our district than on any other House race nationwide. 3. According to Nate Silver’s latest update, this is still a toss-up district. As of today, we are holding the line against this MAGA spending. In 2024, billionaires like Elon Musk were able to drag Mike Lawler across the finish line in NY-17, even while Kamala won the district. I’m counting on this grassroots team to help me make sure history doesn’t repeat itself. There are no paths for Democrats to take back the House without beating Lawler. There is no room for error in a race this competitive. So please, if you can afford it, chip in $10 before our final FEC deadline so we can flip NY-17. Have a great day. Massachusetts Republican State Committee Members, RTC Leaders, and Activists,
As Republicans, we all know that a personal message from a friend carries far more weight than a political advertisement.
I hope you will take a few minutes to try Mike Minogue's new Friend-to-Friend Texting program. It is simple: download the Numinar app, match your contacts, and send a personal message to friends and family who may still need a reminder to vote.

We're running out of time.
In 24 hours we hit the final FEC deadline of this entire campaign. This is our final opportunity to raise the resources we need and show our strength before November 3rd.
Here's why this deadline matters more in the Granite State than anywhere else in the country:
In other states campaigns can lock in early votes weeks ahead of time.
**But in New Hampshire, there is no early voting. In 2024, about ninety percent of voters cast their ballots on Election Day -- so we need every resource available until the final polls close.**
What we raise right now funds organizers knocking doors, calls reaching voters, and our message that has to reach every corner of this state before November 3rd.
**That 's why we set a goal to raise $350,000 by midnight tomorrow, and right now we're on track to fall short.**
**[So I'm asking you directly: Will you chip in $25 right now to help us close the gap before our final FEC deadline? If $25 isn't possible, even $5 makes a real difference. Every dollar counts toward the number everyone will be watching.](https://substack.com/redirect/ab9a8d63-f80f-424a-8ac9-a8de98fb0d43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/ab9a8d63-f80f-424a-8ac9-a8de98fb0d43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
_The numbers only tell part of the story._
Over the past year and a half, I've sat down with Granite Staters in every corner of this state.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ab9a8d63-f80f-424a-8ac9-a8de98fb0d43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/ab9a8d63-f80f-424a-8ac9-a8de98fb0d43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I've met small-business owners, seniors, students, and people who are just trying to get by. Many of them wonder whether anyone in Washington is paying attention to what's happening in their communities.
They're who this campaign is for, and they're why it's powered by everyday people, not corporate PACs or MAGA billionaires.
That's why tomorrow's deadline matters so much.
**There are no more reports after midnight tomorrow.** This is the last fundraising number the media, national Republicans, and Donald Trump will see.
John Sununu and his corporate special interest backers have already poured more than $60 million in outside money into New Hampshire. It's flooding our airwaves with attack ads. They think outside money can decide this race, and right now they're watching our numbers for any sign of weakness.
I'm not going to let them find one, but I can't do it alone.
The resources we raise by tomorrow night are the resources we'll have when it counts. And with only 21 days left in this race, there's no time to take our foot off the gas.
I don't want to head into the final stretch of this race knowing we came up short. If you've been waiting for the right moment to give, this is it. **[Will you make a contribution of $25, $50, or whatever you can before midnight tomorrow?](https://substack.com/redirect/ab9a8d63-f80f-424a-8ac9-a8de98fb0d43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/ab9a8d63-f80f-424a-8ac9-a8de98fb0d43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
After tomorrow it's an all-out sprint to Election Day.
This is our final opportunity to show what this campaign is made of. We'll keep showing up, keep listening, and with your support, defeat John Sununu and win this race.
Thank you for being part of it,
Chris
P.S. **[This is our final FEC deadline: our last chance to raise resources and show our strength before Election Day. There are no second chances after midnight tomorrow. If you've given before, please give again today. If you've never given, there's no more important time to start.](https://substack.com/redirect/ab9a8d63-f80f-424a-8ac9-a8de98fb0d43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

---
| | | | | | | | | | |

| | | | | | | | | | | |

**Welcome to the final stretch of our campaign!**
.With the 2026 Midterm Election just weeks away, this interactive grassroots newsletter is your central hub for the final push to bring true representation back to the hardworking constituents of Illinois' 6th Congressional District.
.Our campaign has always been built on a "district-first" mentality, prioritizing your needs through sensible solutions and open dialogue. Now, we need your help to cross the finish line. As we continue to provide you with regular updates on policy, campaign events, and current community events happening right here in our district, your active participation is more critical than ever.
.Please click the button below to make a donation today—your grassroots contributions are what make this possible.

# Kitchen Table Tuesday
---
| | **Educating and connecting** with voters on important issues.
---
| | |
---
| | Right now, hardworking families across Illinois’ 6th Congressional District are feeling an intense financial strain at the gas pump, where elevated energy prices continue to eat away at household savings. While politicians in Washington often blame global markets and international conflicts for base fuel fluctuations, the stark reality is that the **Democrats’ relentless high-tax agenda is the true driver making Illinois an outlier in pain.** One only needs to cross state borders into neighbors like Indiana or Wisconsin to see the glaring disparity in prices, where commuters pay significantly less for the exact same gallon of fuel. **In our state, everyday citizens and local small businesses are subjected to compounded burdens—from among the highest gas taxes in the nation to looming double-digit toll increases—all backed by Democrats like Sean Casten** to fund reckless government spending and bankroll special interests instead of delivering practical relief.
.As an energy consultant, I understand the market and regulatory forces behind utility and fuel rates, and I know that Illinois cannot tax and spend its way to prosperity. To reverse this crisis and lower prices for families at the federal-level, Congress must put a stop to tax hikes on working families, rein in runaway spending, and reject overreaching green mandates that choke domestic energy supplies. In the U.S. House, **I will fight for a "speed to power" framework that cuts red tape in the energy industry, restores competitive markets, and puts our local taxpayers first.** It is time to deliver common-sense fiscal accountability, stop punishing Illinois drivers for failed partisan policies, and bring genuine affordability back to our kitchen tables.
---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | |
## The Conforti Brief
---
| | **Informing voters** on current events and how Niki plans to help them once in office.
---
| | **The Affordability Illusion: How Democrat Tax-and-Spend Policies Hurt Your Wallet****.
** A recent Fox News opinion article highlights how the **Democratic "affordability" agenda is essentially a rebranding of their classic "tax-and-spend" policies.** The article points out that instead of fixing the root causes of high costs—such as supply shortages, lack of competition, and overregulation—these policies simply subsidize demand, put the bill on the national credit card, and drive up both the federal debt and taxes.
.This mirrors the financial struggles currently facing Illinois' 6th Congressional District. Democrats, like incumbent Sean Casten, are pushing for increased spending on nonessential programs that benefit people in foreign countries, while forgetting about hardworking American families. Because of his failures in reining in wasteful spending, **Sean Casten has earned the “Big Spender” designation from the National Taxpayers Union.** This unchecked borrowing adds to the national debt to pay for the Left's radical spending, placing an enormous and unsustainable burden on our children and grandchildren. More spending inevitably leads to more taxes. Illinoisans are already regularly burdened with higher tolls and higher taxes. Congress pursuing a high tax agenda, coupled with policies that will create even higher utility rates, would make Illinois even less affordable.
.**Niki Conforti maintains a "district-first" mentality** and is committed to delivering sensible solutions to tackle the affordability crisis. If elected, Niki plans to take direct action to provide relief to constituents by:
.
* **Lowering Energy Costs:** Niki will push for legislation that cuts regulations in the energy industry and limits the renewable energy component. This approach focuses on pushing speed to power, making energy more resilient and more affordable.
* **Fixing Healthcare:** Niki will tap into her professional expertise in the health care industry to push for legislation that increases transparency in medical billing and drives up competition in the health care market place - driving down prices for patients. She also supports allowing consumers to purchase health insurance across state lines and expanding Health Savings Accounts (HSAs).
* **Implementing Spending Caps:** Niki will work to curb the spending in Washington and stop tax increases on working families. When in Washington she will work to push for spending caps to limit the amount we add to the national debt in order to pay for the Left's radical spending.
* **Stimulating Economic Growth:** Niki plans to pass legislation that aims to stimulate economic growth and business activity. She will work to stimulate the return of manufacturing to the 6th district and provide relief getting people back to work.
.

**We cannot tax and spend our way to prosperity.** It is time for sensible solutions that protect your wallet and secure our nation's financial future.
.
Stay informed on this issue—[**read the full breakdown here.**](https://us.list-manage.com/LPUfgU1YgKW?e=25f4fa3311&c2id=7b058fb5598c3e136d157ed790328086)

****Plant a sign in your yard today** and watch our grassroots movement grow!
---
| |

| | **Show Your Support: Request a Yard Sign Today!**
.As we approach the November 3rd General Election, grassroots engagement is essential to defeating incumbent Sean Casten. You can help spread the word and showcase our "district-first" mentality by placing a Niki Conforti yard sign in your yard. **Visible community support is a powerful way to show your neighbors that we are united** in the fight for economic affordability, community safety, and sensible solutions for the 6th District.
.To request a sign for your home or business, please contact our team at [**info@conforti4congress.com.**](mailto:info@conforti4congress.com?subject=Requesting%20a%20Yard%20Sign&body=) Strong local momentum is the key to curbing reckless spending and securing a safer future for Illinois families.
.
Let us know you would like a sign, and we will arrange to get one to you right away!.
.
.
**Key Dates for the 2026 General Election (DuPage County)**
* First day to apply for a vote-by-mail ballot:**August 5th**
* Early voting and vote-by-mail voting begins: **September 24th**
* Last day to request a vote-by-mail ballot: **October 29th**
* Last day for early voting: **November 2nd**
* General Election Day:**November 3rd**
.

**Key Dates for the 2026 General Election (Cook County)**
* First day to apply for a vote-by-mail ballot: **August 5th**
* First day to vote early in Chicago (Downtown Only): **September 24th** Last day for online voter registration: **October 18th**
* Early voting opens in all 50 city wards and suburban Cook County: **October 19th**
* Deadline for vote-by-mail applications: **October 29th**
* General Election Day: **November 3rd**
.

**Get out the vote:** whether you plan to vote by mail, early voting in person, or voting in person on election day, it’s important we get out the vote to defeat incumbent Sean Casten.

Peter, I think my interest in engineering started with my dad.

Growing up, I spent a lot of time with him on his construction job sites, where the engineer was the person everyone looked to for answers. I was good at math and science, and with encouragement from my teachers and family, I eventually earned my engineering degree.

**Looking back, I'm so grateful that I had people in my corner who encouraged me to follow my curiosity. Because for much of history, a girl like me wouldn't have had that opportunity.**

For centuries, women were routinely excluded from the mathematics and physical sciences. Many weren't given access to formal education, and universities largely shut their doors to women. _Womentech_ Network states that "girls often receive less encouragement to pursue STEM subjects in school" and "are less likely to receive venture capital funding and research grants."

Women fought for generations for their rightful place in the STEM fields. On Ada Lovelace Day, I think about trailblazers like Ada Lovelace, Katherine Johnson, Gerty Cori, and Judith A. Resnik, who changed the world. **Today, in their honor, we must keep fighting so our girls have every opportunity to succeed.**

I can't imagine how much brilliance has been overlooked because a girl wasn't encouraged to enjoy math class, couldn't afford college, or was told that engineering wasn't for her.

In Congress, I will fight back the best way I know how, by championing funding for public education, strong schools, and an economy with limitless opportunities and enough room to let dreams grow.

**[That's a future worth fighting for. And I'd love to have you with me in that fight. Will you chip in $5 toward our $10,000 mid-month goal to help me keep fighting for the next generation of trailblazers?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141304833/653125385/-2014245750?refcode=em26_261013_mm1_fnd_clq_act___mm1_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_261013_mm1_fnd_clq_act___mm1_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=7b4aaf70-0ec7-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YjRhYWY3MC0wZWM3LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iju3jMJXmg5rWKO656DiPRszhxd7AVmayILbmuXJDO8=)**

I can't imagine how much brilliance has been overlooked because a girl wasn't encouraged to enjoy math class, couldn't afford college, or was told that engineering wasn't for her. In Congress, I will fight back the best way I know how, by championing funding for public education, strong schools, and an economy with limitless opportunities and enough room to let dreams grow. = Thank you, Christina Christina Bohannan is a mom, law professor, engineer and former state representative. **TUESDAY, OCTOBER 13, 2026**
My grandmother rarely admonished without a proverb. As I became a mother, raised my children, and now a grandparent, her words return--each time revealing another layer of wisdom.
This is the gift of the hoary head: not merely remembering wise words, but knowing when to offer them. The heritage is not merely what we inherit, but what we are entrusted to carry forward.
A chant simplifies until repetition replaces thought. It strips away the "why" and the "how" until only a rhythmic, hollow shell remains.
A proverb distills a life's experience into words that continue to teach us. My grandmother's proverbs call me back to the living of them, their meaning unfolding as life gives me new eyes to see.
Words can close the mind--or keep teaching it.
**Pause.**
**Breathe.**
**Look Deeper.**
**Refuel.**
**Welcome to Sweet Ground.**

As I became a mother, raised my children, and now a grandparent, her words return--each time revealing another layer of wisdom. This is the gift of the hoary head: not merely remembering wise words, but knowing when to offer them. The heritage is not merely what we inherit, but what we are entrusted to carry forward. A chant simplifies until repetition replaces thought. It strips away the "why" and the "how" until only a rhythmic, hollow shell remains. A proverb distills a life's experience into words that continue to teach us. My grandmother's proverbs call me back to the living of them, their meaning unfolding as life gives me new eyes to see. # **Ilhan Omar investigation reportedly nicknamed "World War Eleven"**
A senior administration official said the federal probe into congresswoman Ilhan Omar is internally **[nicknamed"World War Eleven,"](https://substack.com/redirect/bf400807-d0a4-49cd-bace-67cb65e49a33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** referencing Omar's past on-camera slip confusing World War II.

---|---|---
* **Federal agents searched Rep. Ilhan Omar 's D.C. home Monday under a judicially authorized warrant** tied to an ongoing criminal investigation reportedly focused on immigration paperwork filed by her father when she was a child; DOJ confirmed the search without naming Omar specifically.
* **Omar accused the administration of political targeting,** saying she "will not be silenced." The raid follows earlier confirmations from officials including DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin and border czar Tom Homan that a criminal investigation into her immigration history was underway.

* * *
# **Catholic leaders urge soldiers to refuse role in livestreamed execution**
Archbishop Timothy Broglio told Catholic soldiers assigned to the Pentagon's planned firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan **[to seek religious exemptions,](https://substack.com/redirect/69ae1b7c-74fb-4135-b627-77f31a729601?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** questioning whether publicly broadcasting the Dec. 3 execution would serve any purpose beyond mimicking terrorist tactics.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/69ae1b7c-74fb-4135-b627-77f31a729601?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* **Trump said he hasn 't decided whether to approve the livestream,** telling the press that he is considering the broadcast to thwart future terrorists from acting out. **Health Savings Accounts Can Curb Rising Costs** Congress should expand a tool that lets Americans keep more of their money and spend less on healthcare. By Bobby Jindal & Charlie Katebi
---
America’s employers are bracing for their largest increase in healthcare costs in more than two decades. A new survey from the consulting firm Marsh projects that the average worker’s health spending will rise 8.2% next year. That should alarm the roughly 180 million Americans covered by employer-sponsored insurance who will face higher premiums, bigger deductibles and slower wage growth. Healthcare costs have imposed a financial burden on workers and businesses for decades. Between 2001 and 2025, the average cost of medical care for a family of four with employer-based coverage rose 317% from $8,414 to $35,119. A 2024 study estimates that rising premiums cost the average family $125,340 in lost earnings between 1988 and 2019. Meanwhile, the share of workers at small businesses with access to employer-sponsored insurance has fallen from 61.6% to 50.5% since 2008.

I'm on the ballot this year, but nobody's running against me. So I asked myself a simple question: where can I help flip one seat before November 3rd?
My answer is a state House race in southern Wake County. If you only read only one line, read this one: **chip in and split a contribution of $25 or $50 with Winn Decker[right here](https://substack.com/redirect/dbf9e4a5-3eaa-4b18-8714-66e02a169899?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**
Here's why this race matters so much.
#### **Gerrymandering is why so few seats are in play**
I know what gerrymandering does. It ended my time in Congress.
It's the same story in the state House. In 2024, Democratic candidates for the NC House won 51.2% of the vote statewide. Republicans won 47.5%. But Republicans walked away with 71 of 120 seats (59%). That's not an accident. That's Republican gerrymandering.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dbf9e4a5-3eaa-4b18-8714-66e02a169899?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
When the lines are drawn that way, most districts are decided before anybody votes. Only a handful of seats are actually up for grabs. That's exactly why the very few competitive districts matter so much.
#### **The math on the NC House**
Republicans hold 71 seats. Democrats hold 47, and there are 2 independents who used to be Democrats. It takes 61 for a majority. That means Democrats need 12 more seats.
That's a tall order. But you don't win a majority by only playing in the easy seats. You win it in places like House District 37, where Republican Erin Pare has won by single digits every time since 2020.
#### **Why this seat?**
In 2024, Pare beat Safiyah Jackson 51.4% to 45.3%. That's just a few thousand votes in a district of over 100,000 people.
We crunched the numbers, and on the same ballot, voters in that district gave Jeff Jackson and Rachel Hunt about 52% of the vote. Southern Wake voters are open to Democrats. They just need a reason.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dbf9e4a5-3eaa-4b18-8714-66e02a169899?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Even the conservative John Locke Foundation now rates this district [a pure toss-up](https://substack.com/redirect/c7e53b91-f920-41b9-94ba-7f73a2f20810?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
And things are moving our way in Southern Wake. Last November, Fuquay-Varina elected Democrat Bill Harris as mayor over the Republican incumbent. Holly Springs did the same with Mike Kondratick.
I know these precincts well. I beat Bo Hines in 2022 in a district that covered these same neighborhoods. These are the independent-minded voters who sent me to Congress.
#### **Erin Par e's record**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/33df3fea-e177-41fb-b0b1-b1d6d8f0013b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This isn't about Erin Pare as a person. It's about how she votes. And she votes with the MAGA Republican leadership over and over again.
_She voted to gerrymander our maps**again.**_ Last October, as part of Donald Trump's push to redraw maps across the country, Republicans redrew our congressional map in the middle of the decade. The senator who drew it said the goal was simple: one more Republican seat. Pare voted yes.
_She voted to take control of our elections board away from the governor._ In December 2024, Pare voted to override Governor Cooper's veto of Senate Bill 382, which handed control of the State Board of Elections to the newly elected Republican state auditor.
_She voted to ban most abortions after 12 weeks._ In 2023, every Republican in the House voted to override Governor Cooper's veto, Pare included. One Republican vote against, and it would have failed.
_She voted to let Duke Energy raise your rates._ Last summer, Pare voted to override Governor Stein's veto of Senate Bill 266, which lets Duke charge customers for new power plants before they're even built.
Winn Decker will fight for our public schools. He's the son of two public school teachers. [He gets it.](https://substack.com/redirect/b2651496-55cd-4886-9258-dde8556bfb59?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
#### **Support Winn Decker for District 37**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dbf9e4a5-3eaa-4b18-8714-66e02a169899?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
When I take office as your District Attorney in January, I'll be running the most understaffed prosecutor's office in North Carolina. The General Assembly funds 45 prosecutors in Wake County. The state's own formula says we need 70. This year's budget added new prosecutors all over the state, and Wake County got zero.
That means victims will have to wait years instead of months for justice, and repeat offenders will stay out on the streets much longer. We'll all be less safe as a result.
Here's what gets me. Erin Pare is one of the chairs of the House Appropriations Committee, one of the people who actually writes the state budget. She's one of only two Republicans in the House from Wake County. She took my call on this, and I appreciate that. But Wake still got nothing.
If one of the top budget writers in the House can't get funding for her own county's prosecutors, then what's the point of keeping her there? I know one thing for sure, Winn Decker will fight for public safety in Wake County.
#### **What changes if we flip the House?**
A Democratic House can't do everything on its own. Republicans will probably still run the Senate. But a Democratic majority means bad bills are DOA in the House. No more gerrymandered maps (which the governor can't veto). No more veto overrides on abortion, elections, or the environment. That's real power, and it runs through seats like this one.
#### **Why your money matters here**
As of the last public reports on June 30th, Pare had raised about $363,000. Winn had raised about $173,000. She outraised him more than 2 to 1.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dbf9e4a5-3eaa-4b18-8714-66e02a169899?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In a congressional race, $50 is a drop in the bucket. In a state House race that could be decided by a few hundred votes it's mail, digital ads, and money to support volunteers knocking doors in Holly Springs and Fuquay-Varina. In a district this close, a few hundred bucks could be the difference.
#### **Here 's my ask**
Chip in $25, $50, or whatever you can for my campaign and Winn's. Our goal is $5,000 by Election Day, and I'll share updates as we get closer.
[DONATE NOW](https://substack.com/redirect/dbf9e4a5-3eaa-4b18-8714-66e02a169899?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
If you're in southern Wake County, [vote early ](https://substack.com/redirect/aed26211-398f-40a2-8055-15b559db1e1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)and support Winn. If you're not, this is one of the best places in North Carolina for your money to make a real difference.
Let's go win this one.
Wiley
PS: Want to meet the guy leading the fight to flip the House? Robert Reives, the Democratic Leader in the NC House, is coming to my home in Cary on Thursday, October 22nd. Come say hello, ask your questions, and hear straight from him what it'll take to flip those 12 seats. [RSVP to the fundraiser here](https://substack.com/redirect/bcdb880b-97c6-40b8-ab8e-6b276956a20c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

| | Patriot,

It’s Nicole Beus Harris.

My husband, Andy Harris, is currently wrapping up his final town hall before **Early Voting begins on October 22nd.**

However, I wanted to reach out to you directly because we need your help.

Andy has been working tirelessly for the American people to **restore fiscal responsibility, secure our borders,** and **cut the runaway inflation** hurting our families.

But because he is one of the ONLY voices standing up to the Washington Swamp, **the Democrats want him out desperately.**

They know that when people learn what these facilities actually bring—drained aquifers, massive energy spikes equal to hundreds of thousands of homes, 24/7 low-frequency noise pollution, and miles of high-voltage transmission lines through wild landscapes—they say no. So they are trying to cram them onto federal land before anyone notices. [**This is a corporate land grab of epic proportions. With exactly three weeks until Election Day, the politicians in Congress who rubber-stamped these backroom deals and cheered on the industrialization of our public lands are on the ballot. They are banking on the assumption that you will stay home or stay quiet while they hand over thousands of acres of wild spaces to corporate developers. **We are not going to stay quiet.** When voters know the truth, these candidates lose. But we only have three weeks left to reach them before the polls close.
